title: Ep 1: The Signal Speaks
summary: The crew detects a strange frequency from the neutron star that whispers Mara's name. Commander Hale tries to dismiss it, but the static repeats her identity.

title: Ep 2: The Countdown Begins
summary: Jin traces the strange signal to a neutron star forty light-years away, where a mysterious countdown suddenly begins on the main display.

title: Ep 3: Orders of Silence
summary: Commander Hale orders complete silence as power drops and station lights begin flickering in sync with the countdown.

title: Ep 4: Seven Crew. Eight Voices.
summary: An eighth voice echoes inside the locked control deck, terrifying the crew when they realize only seven of them are present.
